objectives.label: Join the bucket brigade and put out the fire at the {place}

title: Fire at the {place}!
The bucket brigade
summary: The {place} in {settlement} is burning. Every hand to the buckets!
offer: Fire! The {place} is alight and the wind is up — grab a bucket and run!
complete: It's out. The {place} will need mending, but the street is saved. Thank you.
